description: Finds the users of this WordPress install by a search word, or lists them: id, display name, email, and the avatar address. Read-only, it changes nothing. Use it when the host names the person whose face should stand on the page (that is wi_change_host_photo), instead of asking for a user id nobody knows. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers.

limit.description: How many users to return, 1-100. Default 20.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

term.description: Part of the name or the email address. Leave it out to list the users.

name: wi_find_wordpress_user
title: Find a WordPress user as the host
